items.en: My life won't be good until I feel happy.
items.zh_working: 除非我感到开心，否则我的生活不会好。

items.en: My thoughts and feelings mess up my life.
items.zh_working: 我的想法和感受把我的生活搞得一团糟。

items.en: If I feel sad or afraid, then something must be wrong with me.
items.zh_working: 如果我感到难过或害怕，那一定是我出了问题。

items.en: The bad things I think about myself must be true.
items.zh_working: 我对自己想的那些坏话一定是真的。

items.en: I don't try out new things if I'm afraid of messing up.
items.zh_working: 如果害怕搞砸，我就不去尝试新事物。

items.en: I must get rid of my worries and fears so I can have a good life.
items.zh_working: 我必须摆脱担忧和恐惧，才能过上好日子。

items.en: I do all I can to make sure I don't look dumb in front of other people.
items.zh_working: 我会竭尽所能，确保自己不在别人面前出丑。

items.en: I try hard to erase hurtful memories from my mind.
items.zh_working: 我努力把伤人的记忆从脑子里抹掉。

items.en: I can't stand to feel pain or hurt in my body.
items.zh_working: 我受不了身体上的疼痛或难受。

items.en: If my heart beats fast, there must be something wrong with me.
items.zh_working: 如果心跳变快，一定是我出了问题。

items.en: I push away thoughts and feelings that I don't like.
items.zh_working: 我把不喜欢的想法和感受推开。

items.en: I stop doing things that are important to me whenever I feel bad.
items.zh_working: 一感觉不好，我就停下对我重要的事。

items.en: I do worse in school when I have thoughts that make me feel sad.
items.zh_working: 当我有让我难过的想法时，我在学校表现得更差。

items.en: I say things to make me sound cool.
items.zh_working: 我说一些让自己显得很酷的话。

items.en: I wish I could wave a magic wand to make all my sadness go away.
items.zh_working: 我希望自己能挥一挥魔法棒，让所有悲伤都消失。

items.en: I am afraid of my feelings.
I can't be a good friend when I feel upset.
items.zh_working: 当我心烦意乱时，我没办法做好朋友。

scores.label: 心理不灵活性总分（17题）
scores.description: 十七题求和，范围 0–68。分数越高表示越多报告被想法与感受缠住、回避内心体验并因此影响重要活动。不是诊断，也不给学生贴标签。

missingPolicy: complete_required；任一题缺失则该分数不计算，不插补、不补0。
